DESeqDataSet checkpoint from the RNA-seq lesson

Source: R/dds.R
dds.Rd

DESeqDataSet built in the lesson "De las cuentas de RNA-seq a la exploración de datos" (vignette("intro_RNAseq_es")), ready to be used as the starting point of later lessons.

Usage

dds

Format

A DESeqDataSet with 13,596 genes and 99 samples. Its colData is metadata_cleaned plus a Volunteer_ID column.

Source

Generated from filtered_txi and metadata_cleaned.

Details

Steps: DESeqDataSetFromTximport() from filtered_txi and metadata_cleaned with design ~ Cell_type + Group (reference levels monocyte and Ctrl), removal of genes with fewer than 10 reads in at least 10 samples, and estimateSizeFactors().

Requires the DESeq2 package (Bioconductor) to be used. The script that generates it is data-raw/lesson2_checkpoints.R.

See also

zscore_mat, filtered_txi, metadata_cleaned

Examples

if (requireNamespace("DESeq2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  library(DESeq2)
  dds
  design(dds)
}
